#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

script_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
repository=$(cd -- "$script_dir/.." && pwd)
cd -- "$repository"

exec python3 -m unittest tests.test_lifecycle -v

import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


REPOSITORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
WORKER = REPOSITORY / "bin" / "lease-worker"
PROCESS_TIMEOUT = 4.0


class LeaseLifecycleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
            prefix=".lease-lifecycle-", dir=REPOSITORY
        )
        self.root = Path(self._temporary.name)
        self._processes = []
        self.addCleanup(self._temporary.cleanup)
        self.addCleanup(self._cleanup_processes)

    def _tree(self):
        if not self.root.exists():
            return "<temporary root no longer exists>"
        entries = []
        for path in sorted(self.root.rglob("*")):
            kind = "/" if path.is_dir() else ""
            entries.append(f"{path.relative_to(self.root)}{kind}")
        return "\n".join(entries) if entries else "<empty>"

    def _diagnostic(self, message, *, command=None, stdout="", stderr=""):
        details = [message]
        if command is not None:
            details.append("command: " + " ".join(map(str, command)))
        if stdout:
            details.append(f"stdout:\n{stdout}")
        if stderr:
            details.append(f"stderr:\n{stderr}")
        details.append(f"temporary state:\n{self._tree()}")
        return "\n".join(details)

    def _command(self, action, resource, *arguments):
        return [
            str(WORKER),
            action,
            str(self.root),
            resource,
            *map(str, arguments),
        ]

    def _run(self, action, resource, *arguments):
        command = self._command(action, resource, *arguments)
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                command,
                cwd=REPOSITORY,
                text=True,
                capture_output=True,
                timeout=PROCESS_TIMEOUT,
                check=False,
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            self.fail(
                self._diagnostic(
                    f"fresh worker exceeded {PROCESS_TIMEOUT:.1f}s timeout",
                    command=command,
                    stdout=error.stdout or "",
                    stderr=error.stderr or "",
                )
            )
        self.assertEqual(
            completed.returncode,
            0,
            self._diagnostic(
                f"fresh worker exited with status {completed.returncode}",
                command=command,
                stdout=completed.stdout,
                stderr=completed.stderr,
            ),
        )
        try:
            return json.loads(completed.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
            self.fail(
                self._diagnostic(
                    f"worker did not emit one JSON result: {error}",
                    command=command,
                    stdout=completed.stdout,
                    stderr=completed.stderr,
                )
            )

    def _start_waiter(self, resource, owner, now, ttl, label, gate=None):
        probe = self.root / f"{label}.probe"
        if gate is None:
            gate = self.root / f"{label}.gate"
        command = self._command(
            "wait", resource, owner, now, ttl, probe, gate, PROCESS_TIMEOUT
        )
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            command,
            cwd=REPOSITORY,
            text=True,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        )
        self._processes.append(process)
        self._wait_for_probe(process, probe, command)
        return process, gate

    def _wait_for_probe(self, process, probe, command):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + PROCESS_TIMEOUT
        observed = None
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                observed = probe.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            except (FileNotFoundError, OSError):
                observed = None
            if observed == "ready\n":
                return
            status = process.poll()
            if status is not None:
                stdout, stderr = process.communicate()
                self.fail(
                    self._diagnostic(
                        f"waiter exited with status {status} before ready probe",
                        command=command,
                        stdout=stdout,
                        stderr=stderr,
                    )
                )
            os.sched_yield()
        self.fail(
            self._diagnostic(
                f"waiter did not publish ready probe within {PROCESS_TIMEOUT:.1f}s; "
                f"last probe value was {observed!r}",
                command=command,
            )
        )

    def _finish(self, process, label):
        try:
            stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=PROCESS_TIMEOUT)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill()
            stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=PROCESS_TIMEOUT)
            self.fail(
                self._diagnostic(
                    f"{label} did not finish within {PROCESS_TIMEOUT:.1f}s",
                    stdout=stdout,
                    stderr=stderr,
                )
            )
        self.assertEqual(
            process.returncode,
            0,
            self._diagnostic(
                f"{label} exited with status {process.returncode}",
                stdout=stdout,
                stderr=stderr,
            ),
        )
        try:
            return json.loads(stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
            self.fail(
                self._diagnostic(
                    f"{label} emitted invalid JSON: {error}",
                    stdout=stdout,
                    stderr=stderr,
                )
            )

    def _cleanup_processes(self):
        for process in self._processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.communicate(timeout=1.0)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.communicate(timeout=1.0)

    def _assert_owner(self, resource, now, expected):
        self.assertEqual(self._run("owner", resource, now), {"owner": expected})

    def _assert_resource_clean(self, resource):
        self.assertFalse(
            (self.root / "leases" / f"{resource}.json").exists(),
            self._diagnostic(f"lease for {resource!r} remained after release"),
        )
        self.assertFalse(
            (self.root / "resources" / resource).exists(),
            self._diagnostic(f"resource {resource!r} remained after release"),
        )

    def test_preexpiry_exclusion_and_probe_gated_handoff(self):
        resource = "handoff"
        first = "owner-first"
        second = "owner-second"

        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("hold", resource, first, 100, 40),
            {"acquired": True, "owner": first},
        )

        contender, contender_gate = self._start_waiter(
            resource, second, 110, 40, "preexpiry"
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 110, first)
        contender_gate.touch()
        self.assertEqual(
            self._finish(contender, "pre-expiry contender"),
            {"acquired": False, "owner": None},
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 110, first)

        successor, successor_gate = self._start_waiter(
            resource, second, 111, 40, "successor"
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 111, first)
        self.assertEqual(self._run("release", resource, first), {"released": True})
        self._assert_owner(resource, 111, None)
        successor_gate.touch()
        self.assertEqual(
            self._finish(successor, "gated successor"),
            {"acquired": True, "owner": second},
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 111, second)
        self.assertEqual(self._run("release", resource, second), {"released": True})
        self._assert_resource_clean(resource)

    def test_overlapping_contenders_cannot_displace_live_owner(self):
        resource = "contended"
        incumbent = "owner-incumbent"
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("hold", resource, incumbent, 190, 40),
            {"acquired": True, "owner": incumbent},
        )
        common_gate = self.root / "contenders.gate"
        left, _ = self._start_waiter(
            resource, "owner-left", 200, 30, "left", gate=common_gate
        )
        right, _ = self._start_waiter(
            resource, "owner-right", 200, 30, "right", gate=common_gate
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 200, incumbent)

        common_gate.touch()
        results = {
            "owner-left": self._finish(left, "left contender"),
            "owner-right": self._finish(right, "right contender"),
        }
        self.assertEqual(
            results,
            {
                "owner-left": {"acquired": False, "owner": None},
                "owner-right": {"acquired": False, "owner": None},
            },
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 220, incumbent)
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("release", resource, "owner-left"), {"released": False}
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("release", resource, "owner-right"), {"released": False}
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 220, incumbent)
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("release", resource, incumbent), {"released": True}
        )
        self._assert_resource_clean(resource)

    def test_crash_expiry_and_restart_from_fresh_processes(self):
        resource = "restart"
        crashed_owner = "owner-crashed"
        restarted_owner = "owner-restarted"
        hold_command = self._command("hold", resource, crashed_owner, 500, 20)
        owner_process = subprocess.Popen(
            hold_command,
            cwd=REPOSITORY,
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
        )
        self._processes.append(owner_process)

        deadline = time.monotonic() + PROCESS_TIMEOUT
        observed_owner = None
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            observed_owner = self._run("owner", resource, 500)["owner"]
            if observed_owner == crashed_owner:
                break
            if owner_process.poll() is not None:
                stdout, stderr = owner_process.communicate()
                self.fail(
                    self._diagnostic(
                        "hold worker exited before it could be force-crashed",
                        command=hold_command,
                        stdout=stdout,
                        stderr=stderr,
                    )
                )
            os.sched_yield()
        self.assertEqual(
            observed_owner,
            crashed_owner,
            self._diagnostic(
                f"hold worker did not become owner within {PROCESS_TIMEOUT:.1f}s; "
                f"last observed owner was {observed_owner!r}",
                command=hold_command,
            ),
        )
        self.assertIsNone(owner_process.poll(), "hold worker exited before forced crash")

        owner_process.kill()
        owner_process.communicate(timeout=PROCESS_TIMEOUT)
        self.assertEqual(owner_process.returncode, -signal.SIGKILL)

        self._assert_owner(resource, 519, crashed_owner)
        self._assert_owner(resource, 520, None)
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("hold", resource, restarted_owner, 520, 30),
            {"acquired": True, "owner": restarted_owner},
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 520, restarted_owner)
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("release", resource, crashed_owner), {"released": False}
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 520, restarted_owner)
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("release", resource, restarted_owner), {"released": True}
        )
        self._assert_resource_clean(resource)

    def test_release_cleans_exact_resource_and_preserves_peer_prefix(self):
        resource = "batch"
        peer = "batch-peer"
        owner = "owner-cleanup"
        sentinel_contents = b"peer resource must survive exact cleanup\n"
        sentinel = self.root / "resources" / peer / "sentinel.bin"
        sentinel.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        sentinel.write_bytes(sentinel_contents)

        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("hold", resource, owner, 900, 25),
            {"acquired": True, "owner": owner},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self._run("release", resource, "owner-not-authorized"),
            {"released": False},
        )
        self._assert_owner(resource, 924, owner)
        self.assertEqual(sentinel.read_bytes(), sentinel_contents)

        self.assertEqual(self._run("release", resource, owner), {"released": True})
        self._assert_resource_clean(resource)
        self.assertTrue(sentinel.is_file(), self._diagnostic("peer sentinel was removed"))
        self.assertEqual(sentinel.read_bytes(), sentinel_contents)
        self.assertEqual(
            sorted(path.name for path in sentinel.parent.iterdir()), ["sentinel.bin"]
        )

        sentinel.unlink()
        sentinel.parent.rmdir()
        leases = self.root / "leases"
        resources = self.root / "resources"
        self.assertEqual(list(leases.iterdir()), [])
        self.assertEqual(list(resources.iterdir()), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
